description: This file defines the SystemStatus class, which encapsulates various system state statuses as static read-only instances, including methods for comparison, string representation, and hash code generation.

classes.name: SystemStatus
classes.description: Represents current system status with predefined static instances for states such as Unknown, Creating, Created, Starting, Running, Stopping, ShuttingDown, and Terminated. Implements equality comparison and overrides ToString, GetHashCode, and Equals methods.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the internal system status value.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the internal system status value.

methods.name: Equals(object obj)
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, casting to SystemStatus if possible.

methods.name: Equals(SystemStatus other)
methods.description: Determines equality with another SystemStatus instance based on the internal status value.
